## 目的 / Purpose

将 Windows 首轮实操标注与报价回收/比价议价的新意见统一为可实施的 UI 整改方案，而非逐个做零散 CSS 修补。
Consolidate Windows UAT feedback and quote/comparison UX comments into one implementable restructuring plan.

**开发基线 / Baseline**: draft/20261013-m1-storage-ui-audit @ f117cf3ca512a4ca7e1eec505b5e28744159343f

### 交付 / Deliverables

1. docs/ui/20261022_SRM_UI_结构整改总方案_V1.md — 中英双语：根因、信息架构、文本线框图、报价回收紧凑视图、安全刷新、比价决策三层结构、共用设计规范、逐阶段实施及参考案例。
2. docs/ui/20261022_SRM_UI_实施验收矩阵_V1.md — 中英双语：反馈追溯、真实代码触点、业务不变量、开发者 GitHub CI 测试、Codex TEST-ONLY 定向验收、回滚与合并门槛。

### 决定原则 / Key decisions

- 报价回收：主表 7 列左右、普通行目标 40–44px、按需展开备注/阶梯价/交期/MOQ；刷新显示不创建轮次或新版本，不覆盖未保存草稿。
- Quote intake: compact primary rows, on-demand details, and a view-only refresh that does not overwrite drafts.
- 比价议价：决策总览 → 逐物料报价与人工定标 → 自身范围/共同范围/理论最低分别统计。
- Comparison: decision overview → line-level award → totals separated by valid comparison scope.
- 统一 RFQ 号和保存状态；业务导出与 S4 恢复管理分离；图纸批量匹配步骤化。
- Consolidate RFQ/save context; separate exports from S4 operations; streamline drawing matching.
- 维护 SQLite、报价历史与锁定、最低价并列、非最低理由、阶梯适用价、供应商隔离、原始 PDF、S4 安全等已验收业务语义。
- Preserve all previously accepted persistence, pricing, provenance, scope, and backup safety semantics.

### 范围与批准门槛 / Scope and approval gate

**DESIGN-ONLY.** Compared against exact baseline: 2 files added under docs/ui; no product code, backend, existing tests or CI changes.
这是设计候选 PR，不是 UI 实施 PR，保持 Draft 等待用户评审，不合并开发基线或 main。
This draft is for design review, not product implementation or delivery; do not merge as a release.

开发版 S3/S4 post-merge CI [39430062548](https://github.com/yudacheng666/SRM_System/actions/runs/39430062548) SUCCESS，但该结果不能代替未来新 UI 的 CI。
Existing baseline CI success does not validate future UI implementation.

用户明确批准布局和交互后，ChatGPT 在同一个产品开发 PR 中分段实现、增加自动化回归并核对 CI；稳定后 Codex Cloud 再做一次有证据的定向 TEST-ONLY 真实浏览器业务验收。
After design approval, ChatGPT implements in one gated product PR; Codex independently performs one targeted TEST-ONLY UAT run.

### 设计参考 / Pattern references
- SAP Ariba Bid Analysis: https://help.sap.com/docs/strategic-sourcing/managing-events-with-guided-sourcing/using-bid-analysis-to-award-guided-sourcing-events
- SAP Ariba Scenarios and Awards: https://help.sap.com/docs/ariba-apis/event-management-api/creating-scenarios-and-awards-with-event-management-api
- Oracle Negotiation Award Lines: https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/procurement/26d/fapra/op-suppliernegotiationawards-auctionheaderid-child-lines-get.html

以上仅参考采购决策信息层级，不引入大型平台新增业务复杂性。
These are presentation-pattern references only, not scope expansion.

issue49.title: [TEST-ONLY][PR46 c2737f0] Codex Cloud 临时独立测试（Actions 受限，不替代 CI）
issue49.body:
## 授权与性质 / Authorization & scope

用户同意：**仅在 GitHub Actions 因账户计费/额度问题无法分配 runner 的期间，允许 Codex Cloud 提前做独立 TEST-ONLY 预验收**；原“准确 SHA 的 GitHub CI 全绿 → 正式独立验收 → 用户批准后合并”规则仍然保留。本任务**不是 CI PASS，也不是发布许可**。

Owner authorizes a temporary independent Codex Cloud TEST-ONLY **pre-CI check** while GitHub Actions cannot allocate runners. Do not promote this to a formal release gate.

**Repository:** `yudacheng666/SRM_System`
**Product PR:** [#46](https://github.com/yudacheng666/SRM_System/pull/46) (Draft)
**Required exact product SHA:** `c2737f0221a7b529114da2df363e062e75c7544c`
**Product ref:** `feat/20261022-srm-ui-ux-structural`
**Design + acceptance criteria:** [PR #44](https://github.com/yudacheng666/SRM_System/pull/44) and `docs/ui/20261022_SRM_UI_实施验收矩阵_V1.md` on its design ref.
**Why CI is unavailable:** [UI workflow 39743002722](https://github.com/yudacheng666/SRM_System/actions/runs/39743002722) and [S3/S4 workflow 39743002740](https://github.com/yudacheng666/SRM_System/actions/runs/39743002740): four jobs `steps=[]`, no runners; GitHub annotation reports recent payment failure **or** insufficient spending limit. This is an environment/account block, not an observed failing product assertion.

## 1. 固定代码及环境 / Freeze source and environment

1. Read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/ai-memory/PROJECT_STATE.md`, `DECISIONS.md` from M1 development branch `draft/20261013-m1-storage-ui-audit`. Also read this Issue, #46, #44 and directly relevant tests. Memory proposals on PR #48 are not automatically merged.
2. Fetch #46 remote head, record start and end HEAD with `git rev-parse`. **Run on the exact SHA above**; if the remote head moved, mark BLOCKED and report; don't silently test another SHA.
3. Use a fresh isolated temp `SRM_DATA_DIR` for each real-browser scenario; synthetic fixtures only; no actual buyer RFQ, vendor quotes, original client documents, external services or credentials.
4. Record actual runner OS, Node/Python versions, browser binary and any missing runtime capabilities. GitHub Actions is **not** available for the task; use Codex Cloud execution, not `workflow_dispatch`, CI rerun or GitHub-hosted runners.

## 2. 开发者套件独立重跑 / Independent local equivalents of blocked CI

Attempt, in a suitable Cloud Linux environment, the actual repository commands from `.github/workflows/srm-ui-v2-unified-acceptance.yml` and `srm-s3-regression.yml`:

```sh
python -m unittest discover -v -s prototype/m1-lite/backend -p 'test_*.py'
npm ci
npm test
npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
npm run test:e2e
```

Record exit codes, totals, elapsed test scope and logs **per command**. Run the newly added `prototype/m1-lite/tests/e2e/ui-ux-structural.spec.cjs` as part of E2E; do not skip, alter or quarantine any failing test. In particular cover 12 synthetic lines (10+2 paging).

For Windows-only PowerShell/batch-launcher checks, execute only if an actual Windows runner is available *outside GitHub Actions*. Otherwise mark NOT TESTED (platform unavailable); do not call Linux emulation equivalent to native Windows PASS. Do not consume GitHub Actions allowance through retries.

## 3. 定向真实采购业务验收 / Targeted Chromium+SQLite buyer UAT

Preserve screenshots, network/API observations and before/after isolated SQLite state where material:

- **Q01–Q04 报价回收:** file/XLSX or paste import, draft preview; refresh must not destroy unconfirmed preview/unsaved note, rewrite SQLite, create a round/revision or misstate save acknowledgement; compact/full columns and actual RFQ Line ID/tiers/lead/MOQ/evidence details.
- **C01–C05 比价议价:** 12-line pending-only genuine filtered pagination (10+2 and no false blank page), selection of one real priced item removes it from pending view, full-scope decision overview preserved; price values, same-scope totals, no zero-value missing bids; tied-lowest selection allowed, higher-price selection demands a persisted reason; opening supplier terms must not award.
- **W01–W04 工作区/安全:** one authoritative RFQ/save status; business exports vs S4 administration; unique/ambiguous PDF association keeps original bytes and line identity; supplier ZIP isolation, S4 complete ZIP and empty-directory-only restore plus nonempty rejection on **isolated synthetic** database.
- **V01 可用性:** 1024×768 / 1366×768 / 1600×900 visible/scrollable main actions, headings and dense price tables. Report UX/readability separately from functional correctness. Screenshots must reflect actual browser rendering.

Use PR #44 UX IDs and acceptance matrix as the source of exact expectations. If exhaustive historical C03–C09 or native Windows is unavailable, explicitly label NOT TESTED rather than manufacturing green coverage. Keep a focused run; no stress/destructive tests against real directories.

## 4. TEST-ONLY 严格禁止 / Restrictions

- **NEVER edit product code, existing test code, CI workflows, AGENTS.md, PROJECT_STATE.md or DECISIONS.md**; do not fix failures in this task. No merges, rebases, force pushes, closing PRs or writing to main/M1/product branches.
- If a test fixture/driver error occurs, preserve original failure and allow at most one documented runner-only correction/rerun; do not change assertions to pass or hide failures.
- If a genuine data-loss, export leakage, pricing corruption or S4 security defect is observed, stop affected risky scenarios and report immediately. Other independent non-risky checks may continue.
- No real company, personal, vendor, product or pricing identifiers in reports, logs or screenshots; commit synthetic/test-only evidence.

## 5. 必须回写 GitHub / Required GitHub deliverables

Create **one Draft evidence-only PR** from a fresh `test/20261022-pr46-c2737f0-temp-ci` branch based on the frozen product SHA, targeting `feat/20261022-srm-ui-ux-structural`. Only add paths under `docs/uat/20261022-pr46-c2737f0-temp-ci/`:

- `REPORT.zh-CN.md`, `REPORT.en.md`: exact SHA, platform, test commands, counts, UX vs business findings, confirmed defects, limitations and next-step recommendation.
- `results.csv`: each case with PASS / FAIL / NOT TESTED / BLOCKED and evidence pointer.
- `raw-error-register.json`: raw failures, driver corrections and retest count; no silent deletion.
- `evidence/`: real screenshots, logs, traces and relevant generated-file verification, as available and safe.
- Links to UI/S3-S4 failed *no-runner* jobs as context, clearly separated from actual Codex local test results.

After creating the Draft evidence PR, comment **both on this Issue and on product PR #46** with: evidence PR URL, exact product SHA, executed/not-executed commands, numeric result, any P1/P2/P3 issue, and blocked scope. Keep issue open for developer response.

**Outcome meaning:** Codex Cloud tests, even if all PASS, are **temporary pre-CI evidence only**. GitHub Actions official exact-SHA verification, ChatGPT review and owner authorization remain mandatory before merging either product branch or main.

**中英双语按行对应，保持真实错误与证据，不修产品。 / Bilingual reports; test only, preserve raw evidence; no product edits.**
